regions.merged_text: Your pathetic letter of a month ago has been on my mind ever since, as your vocation, has been increasingly in my prayers: seeing your intricate problems, your growing embarrassments, your so fearfully threatening dangers to temporal welfare as well as to the (spiritual) - and sadest of all your seemingly unsuspecting blindness, till thanks be to God! your very last, but redeeming paragraph
